name: Eurydice
source:
You had a good life – a decent job, a loving wife, a couple of friends you hung out with… until she disappeared. Out of thin air, or did you force yourself to forget? You had the audacity to forget what happened – to mourn her for a few days and then go back to your nine-to-five like nothing ever happened.
